interface.signature: def isWordExist(board: list[list[str]], word: str) -> bool

preconditions.expression: isinstance(board, list) and all(isinstance(row, list) and all(isinstance(cell, str) and len(cell) == 1 for cell in row) for row in board)
preconditions.description: board is a non-empty 2D list of single-character strings.

preconditions.expression: 1 <= len(board) <= 100 and 1 <= len(board[0]) <= 100 if board else True
preconditions.description: Board dimensions N and M are between 1 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(word) <= len(board) * len(board[0]) if board else True
preconditions.description: Word length L is at most N * M.

postconditions.expression: return_value == any(_dfs(board, word, r, c, 0) for r in range(len(board)) for c in range(len(board[0])))
postconditions.description: The function returns True if and only if there exists a starting cell (r, c) from which the word can be formed by moving to adjacent (horizontal or vertical) cells without reusing any cell, and False otherwise.
